statement: ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : WSpace n × ℝ → F) (p : WSpace n × ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f p → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (wT f) p ∧ ∀ j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (wX f j) p
proof:
intro F _ _ f p hf
constructor
· have hh : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : (WSpace n × ℝ) × ℝ => f (z.1.1,z.2)) (p,p.2) := hf.comp _ (contDiffAt_fst.fst.prodMk contDiffAt_snd)
  simpa only [wT, ← fderiv_apply_one_eq_deriv] using (hh.fderiv contDiffAt_snd (by simp : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ∞)).clm_apply (contDiffAt_const (c := (1 : ℝ)))
· intro j
  have hh : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : (WSpace n × ℝ) × WSpace n => f (z.2,z.1.2)) (p,p.1) := hf.comp _ (contDiffAt_snd.prodMk contDiffAt_fst.snd)
  simpa only [wX, wDx] using (hh.fderiv contDiffAt_fst (by simp : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ∞)).clm_apply (contDiffAt_const (c := Pi.single j (1 : ℝ)))
